    hs_content = body[pos+4:pos+4+hs_len]
    messages.append((hs_type, hs_content))

server_hello = messages[0]
certificate = messages[1]
ske = messages[2]

# Parse the SKE
p_len = struct.unpack('>H', ske[1][0:2])[0]
p = ske[1][2:2+p_len]
g_len = struct.unpack('>H', ske[1][2+p_len:4+p_len])[0]
g = ske[1][4+p_len:4+p_len+g_len]

    struct.pack('>H', sig_len) + sig
)

print(f"New p first bytes: {new_p[:10].hex()}")
print(f"New p last byte: {new_p[-1]:#04x}")

# Build new handshake messages

new_messages.append(server_hello)
new_messages.append(certificate)

# Build the record body

    new_body += bytes([hs_type]) + struct.pack('>I', hs_len)[1:] + hs_content

# Build the record

new_record = bytes([0x16]) + b'\x03\x30' + struct.pack('>H', new_rec_len) + new_body
